title: TwistedCoordinateSectionSign
statement: Fix the finite purity datum $P$ [def-pur-conventions], a $k$-scheme $T$, and a divisibility witness for the affine-line datum [def-pur-affine-line-datum]. In that datum's literal coordinate and scalar presentation, define coordinateCartierOrdinary to be the derived map of the unique ordinary supported relative Kummer class [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. Its exceptional adjunct uses the ordinary proper/closed comparison and adjunction. Define coordinateCartierAdjunct by the exact comparison image of that adjunct, the canonical single-complex and shift comparisons, and the actual comparison-unit right-adjoint map rho [def-pur-bounded-site-transpose-arrows] used in [def-pur-coordinate-section-site-arrows]. CoordinateCartierSign is the proposition that for every such divisibility witness the zero section is Cartier and there exist the normalized support chart and positive coordinate-boundary orientation of [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation], with coordinateCartierAdjunct equal to its negative. The sign is read in the signed relative-cone convention ($D(a,b)=(da,r(a)-db)$, boundary $b\mapsto(0,-b)$) cited by the item.
